items.title: Bootstrap monorepo, docker-compose stack and CI baseline
items.description: Create the pnpm monorepo per REPOSITORY_STRUCTURE (apps/api, apps/web, apps/mocks, packages/{ui,contracts,domain-kit}, seed, e2e). docker-compose with Postgres 16 + pgvector/pg_trgm/ltree/citext, Redis 7, MinIO, Keycloak (realm import), Mailpit, ClamAV. GitHub Actions ci.yml: install, lint, typecheck, unit, gitleaks. `.env.example` with dummy values only. This is the first item on the critical path: every other item depends on it. **Deliver in two pushes:** push 1 within the first 90 minutes of Day 1 (workspace skeleton, empty NestJS and Vite apps, compose services up) unblocks DEV1/DEV2/DEV3; push 2 (CI workflow, lint and test wiring) lands by end of day.
acceptance: Given a clean checkout, when `docker compose up -d && pnpm install && pnpm dev` runs, then api, web, Postgres, Redis, MinIO, Keycloak and Mailpit are healthy within 3 minutes.
Given a PR, when CI runs, then lint, typecheck, unit tests and gitleaks execute and block merge on failure.
No real secret exists in the repo (gitleaks clean).
risks: Toolchain friction on Windows dev machines — provide devcontainer or WSL note.

items.title: Apply reference schema baseline with RLS, ledger triggers and grants
items.description: Turn docs/06-database/SCHEMA.sql into migration 0001 (node-pg-migrate): all schemas (platform, common, strata, fm, ai), RLS loop (ENABLE + FORCE + tenant_isolation policy on every tenant_id table), balanced-journal constraint trigger and period-lock trigger from MIGRATIONS.md, REVOKE UPDATE/DELETE on audit and ledger tables for app_user, separate migrator and app_user roles (no BYPASSRLS). Domain owners may add follow-up migrations; this one is the shared baseline. Urbanise's schema is UNKNOWN (U-01) — this is an independent design.
acceptance: Given a connection as app_user without `app.tenant_id` set, when any tenant table is queried, then 0 rows are returned (TEN-05).
Given tenant A context, when inserting a row with tenant B's id, then RLS WITH CHECK rejects it (TEN-12).
Given an unbalanced journal entry, when the transaction commits, then it fails with UNBALANCED_ENTRY (FIN-03).
Given a closed period, when a journal is inserted for that month, then it fails with PERIOD_CLOSED (FIN-09).
app_user cannot UPDATE/DELETE audit_events, journal_entries or ledger_lines (SEC-12).
risks: RLS misconfiguration silently leaks data — covered by TEN tests in VX-007.

items.title: Implement API core: tenant context, Problem errors, cursor pagination, idempotency, request logging
items.description: NestJS on Fastify core module: TenantContext (from token `tid`) and a transaction helper that runs `SET LOCAL app.tenant_id`; ScopedRepository base; RFC 9457 Problem filter with error codes; HMAC-signed keyset cursor pagination; Idempotency-Key interceptor backed by platform.idempotency_keys; optimistic locking (If-Match); Pino JSON logging with redaction and request/trace IDs; /healthz and /readyz.
acceptance: Given the same Idempotency-Key and body twice, then one write occurs and the replay returns the original response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.
Given the same key with a different body, then 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
Given a tampered cursor, then 400 INVALID_CURSOR.
Every error response is application/problem+json with code and traceId and no stack trace.
Logs never contain Authorization headers, passwords, tokens or bank numbers (SEC-14).

items.title: Implement authentication: Keycloak realm, JWT guard, server-side role resolution, /me
items.description: Integrates with VX-002 (memberships/role_assignments tables) at merge on Day 1 afternoon; development starts in parallel. Keycloak realm export (vertex-web PKCE client, vertex-api bearer-only, TOTP required for staff), seeded synthetic test users from SEED_DATA. API AuthGuard validates JWT via JWKS (iss, aud, exp), resolves membership for `tid`, loads role assignments server-side (60 s cache — ADR-016). GET /me and POST /me/tenant-switch. SSO with Entra ID exists in Urbanise (EV-006, CONFIRMED capability); the protocol is UNKNOWN, so the POC uses OIDC brokering with a second Keycloak realm acting as the corporate IdP for the demo.
acceptance: Given no token, then 401 Problem.
Given a token whose `tid` is not an active membership of the user, then 401.
Given a JWT with alg:none or a wrong key, then 401 (SEC-06).
Given a revoked role assignment, then access is denied within 60 s (RBAC-N14).
Given the demo SSO realm, when a staff user logs in through it, then a session is created in the correct tenant (FT-SH-03).
risks: Keycloak config drift between environments — realm is exported to git.
unknowns: Real Entra ID tenant not available for POC (mock IdP realm used).

items.title: Implement RBAC permission catalog, @Permission guard and route-coverage test
items.description: Static permission catalog (`module.resource.action`) and 13 system roles from the RBAC matrix; PermissionGuard reading @Permission metadata; `can(user, permission, resource)` with scope types (tenant, scheme, lot, region, property, supplier, client); CI test enumerating all routes that fails if a route has neither @Permission nor @Public. Domain teams use the catalog from Day 2.
acceptance: Given any registered route without @Permission or @Public, then the route-coverage test fails (API-PERM-01).
Given strata_manager, when calling a platform.tenant.manage route, then 403 (RBAC-N08).
Given an auditor, when calling any write endpoint, then 403 (RBAC-N09).

items.title: Implement audit writer (hash chain), transactional outbox, BullMQ relay and Clock-based scheduler
items.description: AuditService writing append-only events with per-tenant sha256 hash chain inside the business transaction; outbox insert helper; relay worker publishing unpublished outbox rows to BullMQ queues; idempotent consumer base using platform.processed_events; repeatable-job scheduler with injectable Clock (needed for levy, arrears, PPM, SLA jobs and for deterministic tests). Audit trail is a CONFIRMED capability (EV-013); this implementation is PROPOSED.
acceptance: Given a state change, then an audit event and an outbox event are written in the same transaction (rollback removes both).
Given the relay crashes after publish but before marking, when it restarts, then consumers process the event exactly once (FAILREC-04).
Given the Clock is advanced in a test, then scheduled jobs fire deterministically.
The audit hash chain verifies for a seeded tenant.

items.title: Build Strata money & calculation library with property tests (apportionment, CRN, ageing, allocation, penalty)
items.description: Pure functions in packages/domain-kit and strata/domain: apportionLevy (cents, entitlement-weighted, remainder rules), CRN with Luhn check digit, ageCharges (1–30/31–60/61–90/91+ from due date — OBSERVED EV-028), allocatePayment (oldest due first, penalty last), penalty (simple interest, configurable). The capability that levies are budget-driven is CONFIRMED (EV-020), but the formulas are UNKNOWN (U-20, U-22). These are PROPOSED, configurable defaults pending D-01..D-03.
acceptance: For random budgets (1 c – $10M), 1–2,000 lots and random entitlements, the sum of schedule items per fund equals the levy target exactly (FIN-01).
Worked example from LEVY_ENGINE ($10,000; 10/20/30/40; quarterly) yields 25,000/50,000/75,000/100,000 c (FT-ST-03).
Allocation never exceeds outstanding; any remainder becomes credit (FIN-02).
Bucket totals equal total overdue (FIN-06).
risks: Jurisdiction rules differ (⚖) — defaults must stay configurable.

items.title: Build FM calculation library: business-time SLA, RRULE occurrences, lifecycle formula, WO state table
items.description: Pure, unit-tested functions: addBusinessMinutes(start, minutes, calendar) with holidays and DST (Australia/Sydney); occurrence generator from iCal RRULE in tenant timezone (≤ daily); lifecycle remaining-life with condition factors and cost escalation; declarative WorkOrder transition table with guards (SM-17). SLAs are a CONFIRMED capability (EV-098) but their definitions are UNKNOWN (U-26); the lifecycle method is UNKNOWN (U-27). Both are PROPOSED defaults.
acceptance: Given P3 created Friday 16:30 with a Mon–Fri 08–17 calendar, then the response due time is Monday 16:30.
DST transition tests pass for Australia/Sydney.
Given monthly RRULE and lead 7 days, then occurrences and generation dates are correct for 52 weeks.
An illegal WO transition throws INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.

items.title: Implement web app shell with OIDC login, role-aware navigation and generated API client
items.description: React + Vite + TanStack Router/Query + Tailwind + Radix. OIDC PKCE login against Keycloak; AppShell (sidebar, top bar, tenant switcher, notifications bell placeholder); menus driven by /me permissions and licensed products; route areas /app, /portal, /field, /fm-portal, /pay; API client and zod types generated from packages/contracts (OPENAPI.yaml). Staff UI of Urbanise is UNKNOWN — layouts are PROPOSED.
acceptance: Given a staff user, when logging in, then the role-appropriate menu renders, and Strata/FM sections hide when the tenant does not license them.
Given an expired session, then the user is redirected to login and returned to the original deep link.
The API client compiles from OPENAPI.yaml with no hand-written request types.

items.title: Implement RBAC scope predicates and tenant-isolation / RBAC negative test suites
items.description: scopeFilter(user, permission) SQL fragments for list endpoints (scheme, lot via ownership, property, region, supplier, client). Out-of-scope by-id returns 404. Generated test that hits every GET-by-id route with another tenant's id. Two seeded tenants (T1, T2 with look-alike names) exercise isolation.
acceptance: Given tenant B ids, when tenant A calls any GET-by-id route, then 404 (TEN-01, generated over all routes).
List endpoints never include other-tenant rows (TEN-02).
An owner requesting another lot's ledger in the same scheme gets 404 (RBAC-N01).
A technician requesting another technician's WO gets 404 (RBAC-N04).
risks: Scope logic per resource is easy to miss — suite runs per route.

items.title: Implement document service: presigned upload, AV scan, type validation, visibility/ACL, signed download
items.description: POST /documents (presigned PUT to quarantine bucket) → ClamAV scan worker → magic-byte allow-list, 25 MB cap, sha256 check → move to clean bucket; entity links; visibility levels (staff, committee, owners, lot_owner, contractor, client) per BR-SH-03; 5-minute signed download only after authorization; emits document.scanned for RAG indexing. Document management is a CONFIRMED capability (EV-014, EV-037).
acceptance: An EICAR upload is marked infected and is never downloadable (SEC-10).
A mime-spoofed or polyglot file is rejected (SEC-11).
An owner downloads an owners-visibility by-law (200) but gets 404 for committee-only minutes (DOC-01/02).
A download while scan is pending returns 409 (DOC-05).

items.title: Implement Strata scheme register and provisioning (schemes, buildings, lots, contacts, ownerships)
items.description: APIs for schemes, buildings, lots (entitlement, CRN), contacts, ownerships (effective dates, transfer), occupancies. Scheme creation provisions: Admin + Capital Works funds (BR-ST-01, OBSERVED EV-038), chart of accounts template, trust bank account, and portal site record (CONFIRMED EV-032 auto-provisioned portal). Includes Harbour View and Garden Terrace demo seed for T1 and the look-alike scheme for T2.
acceptance: Given a new scheme, then exactly one admin and one capital works fund, the chart of accounts, a trust account and a portal site exist.
A duplicate registration number per jurisdiction returns 409; a duplicate lot number per scheme returns 409.
Given an ownership transfer, then the previous ownership ends the day before and the strata roll reflects the new owner.
The seed loads T1 (Harbour View 12 lots, Garden Terrace 6 lots) and T2.

items.title: Implement trust ledger posting service, period close and trial balance
items.description: LedgerService.post(entry) with standard postings (levy, penalty, sundry, receipt, supplier invoice, payment, bank fee), reversals referencing the original, lot and supplier sub-ledgers, monthly periods with close guard, trial balance query, and GET /strata/lots/{id}/ledger with running balance. Trust accounting is CONFIRMED as a capability (EV-043), but statutory rules are UNKNOWN (G-05, D-06). This design is PROPOSED.
acceptance: After any random sequence of postings, the trial balance sums to zero (FIN-04).
A reversal restores balances exactly (FIN-08).
The lot ledger shows levy, penalty and receipt lines with a correct running balance (matches OBSERVED EV-039 structure).

items.title: Implement FM properties, location tree, asset types and asset register with demo seed
items.description: APIs for regions, clients, properties (flags such as child_safe and aged_care), ltree locations, asset types (illustrative default lives and costs), and assets (warranty, condition, criticality, replacement cost, GPS, photos via documents). under_warranty flag (EV-091) and asset history endpoint. FM seed: Acme Care, 3 properties, ~60 locations, 220 assets, 2 technicians, SLA policies.
acceptance: A location whose parent belongs to another property is rejected (LOCATION_PROPERTY_MISMATCH).
An asset with future warranty expiry reports underWarranty=true.
Asset list filters by property, type, warranty and condition with cursor pagination.
The seed loads FM demo data for T1.

items.title: Implement shared suppliers, compliance records, status computation and assignment gate
items.description: Supplier register (bank details encrypted, last4 only, change requires step-up/dual control — thin in POC), compliance types (seeded: public liability, workers comp, trade licence, WWC/safeguarding), compliance records with verify/reject, status computation per BR-SUP-01 (compliant, expiring ≤ 30 days, non_compliant), and an `isAssignable(supplier, property, date)` gate used by WO assignment (BR-FM-07, EV-078 safeguarding before site attendance). Compliance types are UNKNOWN (U-28) → PROPOSED seed.
acceptance: A supplier with expired insurance cannot be assigned (422 SUPPLIER_NON_COMPLIANT) (FT-FM-13).
At a child_safe property, a contractor without a verified WWC record is blocked, while the same contractor is allowed elsewhere (FT-FM-14).
Bank account numbers are ciphertext in the DB and appear only as last4 in the API (SEC-21).

items.title: Build UI kit: DataTable, FilterBar, forms, money components, status badges, UX states
items.description: packages/ui: DataTable (server cursor, sort whitelist, filter chips, row actions), EntityHeader, StatusBadge, MoneyText/MoneyInput (cents), LedgerTable, SLAClock, ApprovalCard, DocumentUploader, PhotoCapture, Skeleton/Empty/Error/Permission states, ConfirmDialog with typed confirmation, form wrapper (react-hook-form + zod mapping server `errors[].path`).
acceptance: DataTable pages through 120 rows via cursor with no duplicates.
Server 422 errors map onto the right fields.
axe reports 0 serious issues on the Storybook stories.

items.title: Build mock providers: payments, bank, collections, resident app, SMS, LLM; wire Mailpit
items.description: apps/mocks (Fastify, port 4010): mock-payments (checkout session + hosted Pay/Decline page + HMAC webhooks), mock-bank (CSV/camt.053 statement generator from Vertex pay-ins with noise; payables endpoint), mock-collections (auto-progress referral status), mock-resident-app (UI to submit a request via client credentials; webhook receiver timeline), mock-sms, mock-llm (scripted responses for CI). The integrations are CONFIRMED capabilities (Macquarie/NAB EV-023/049..052, LevyCollect EV-026, Conpago/MyVillage EV-086/087), but their protocols are UNKNOWN, so everything here is a mock (ADR-012).
acceptance: mock-payments emits signed webhooks that verify with the shared secret; a bad signature is rejected by Vertex (INT-T-07).
mock-bank produces a statement with 20 matchable, 3 suggested and 2 unknown lines from seed data.
mock-resident-app can submit a request and display Vertex status webhooks.

items.title: Implement notification dispatcher (email, in-app SSE, SMS mock) with templates, contact preferences and minimal task API
items.description: Notification templates (Handlebars-safe subset), dispatcher worker that resolves ContactPreference channel order with fallback, providers (SMTP→Mailpit, mock-sms, in-app via SSE), retries (3×), statutory notices bypass opt-out (BR-SH-04), and an in-app notification list API. Owner preferred-method communication is CONFIRMED (EV-022), as are assignee notifications (EV-092). Includes a minimal tasks API (platform.tasks: create, assign, complete) used by automation rules such as the arrears L2 call task (EV-012). Notes, timeline and the tasks UI are in FX-22.
acceptance: A contact preferring SMS gets SMS, and email is the fallback when SMS fails (NOT-02).
A statutory notice is sent even when the contact opted out of marketing (NOT-03).
In-app unread count updates within 2 s (NOT-10).
unknowns: Channels beyond email are UNKNOWN for Urbanise (U-32).

items.title: Implement shared approvals engine (requests, routing by amount/scope, decisions, expiry)
items.description: common.approval_requests with subject types (supplier_invoice, quote, variation, budget), approver scope (role + scope + limit), POST /approvals/{id}/decision, GET /approvals?mine, approval-limit enforcement (403 APPROVAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED), 7-day expiry job, and approval.requested/decided events. Committee invoice approval is OBSERVED (EV-040); client variation approvals are CONFIRMED (EV-090).
acceptance: Approving an already-decided request returns 409 (API-STATE-02).
An accountant approving above their limit gets 403 APPROVAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (RBAC-N06).
A committee member sees only their scheme's approvals (RBAC-N16).

items.title: Implement AI gateway with Strata & FM read tools, action proposals and audit
items.description: SSE endpoint POST /ai/conversations/{id}/messages; budget/rate check; intent classification (fast model); Claude tool-use loop (max 6 iterations) over the tool registry. Tools only appear if the user holds the permission, and handlers call domain services as the user (BR-AI-01). Demo-path tools: strata_get_scheme_summary, strata_list_arrears, strata_get_lot_ledger, fm_list_work_orders, fm_sla_at_risk, fm_get_asset, propose_task. Includes action proposals with confirm and 15-minute expiry, persisted messages/tool calls/citations, and audit with actor ai on_behalf_of user. Urbanise's AI model and status are UNKNOWN/CONFLICTED (EV-118, C-01). This design is independent and PROPOSED.
acceptance: Asked for level-2 lots in Harbour View, the assistant lists lots 3 and 7 with exact balances and citations (AIT-01).
A manager scoped to scheme A asking about scheme B gets no B data (AIT-03); same-name scheme in T2 never appears (AIT-04).
A task is created only after Confirm, and the audit shows actor=ai on_behalf_of=user (AIT-09, AIT-24).
During an LLM outage the assistant shows unavailable and the rest of the app works (AIT-20).
unknowns: D-15 LLM provider approval and API key

items.title: Implement budgets, levy schedule generation and automatic levy runs with notices and pay links
items.description: Budget lines by fund/account with states draft → proposed → approved (SM-01); levy preview endpoint; generation of the schedule from the approved budget; daily levy-run job at due − lead_days plus a manual run (Idempotency-Key); charges posted to the ledger; a notice per lot with CRN and a pay link from mock-payments; notice PDF rendered by the worker (Playwright) and stored as a document; notification to owners. Budget-driven automatic issuance is CONFIRMED (EV-020/021), pay-now links are CONFIRMED (EV-050), and the formula is PROPOSED (VX-020). Also POST /strata/charges for sundry charges to lots or non-owner debtors (OBSERVED 'Sundry' debtor type, EV-030), needed for the Aged Debtors Sundry group.
acceptance: Only an approved budget can generate a schedule (BR-ST-02).
When the Clock reaches due − 30 days, each lot gets exactly one notice (PDF + email + pay link), and a re-run creates nothing (FT-ST-05).
Levy charges post DR 1200 / CR 4000 per fund, and the trial balance stays at zero.
A 1,000-lot run completes in under 30 s (PERF-03, may be validated on Day 5).

items.title: Implement payments (pay-now webhook, manual receipt, allocation) and bank statement import with auto-match and reconciliation lock
items.description: Payment webhook (HMAC, idempotent on provider ref) → payment, allocation, receipt notification, credit for overpayment; manual quick receipt; statement import (CSV + camt.053) into bank_transactions with gap/duplicate checks; auto-match rules (provider ref → CRN + amount → amount + date window = suggested); manual match/exclude; reconciliation summary and lock. Automated reconciliation and auto-matching to owner/lot are CONFIRMED (EV-042, EV-051); the matching algorithm is UNKNOWN (U-25) → PROPOSED.
acceptance: A duplicate webhook creates a single payment (INT-T-06, FAILREC-05).
A $50 overpayment becomes credit and auto-applies to the next levy (FT-ST-08).
Seeded statement: ≥ 18 of 20 lines auto-matched, 1 suggested, 1 unmatched (FT-ST-10).
A reconciliation locks only when the difference is 0, and posting to that period is then rejected (FT-ST-11).
A pay-link token for lot A cannot pay lot B's charges (SEC-18).

items.title: Implement service requests, triage and FM work order lifecycle with assignment, evidence and SLA engine
items.description: Service requests (portal, staff, API from mock resident app with idempotent externalId) → triage (priority, category, asset, convert) → WorkOrder (SM-17 guards: assignment gate, check-in, checklist, evidence rule, NTE → awaiting_approval) → assignment (technician/supplier) → transitions endpoint with clientEventId → evidence photos via documents → time entries. SLA engine: due times from policy + calendar, 5-minute at-risk/breach job, pause on hold. Outbound status webhooks to the resident app (fm.workorder.*). Triage, assignment, photo evidence and real-time status back are CONFIRMED (EV-085, EV-086).
acceptance: A resident-app request with the same externalId twice returns the existing request (INT-T-12).
Triage P2 sets SLA due times per calendar, and the warranty flag shows when the asset is under warranty (FT-FM-07).
new → completed directly returns 409 (API-STATE-01); completion without a photo in an evidence-required category returns 422 EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.
Clock at 80% / 100% produces at_risk / breached events and notifications (FT-FM-09); on_hold time extends due times (FT-FM-10).
On completion, mock-resident-app receives a signed webhook with status, completed_at and signed photo URL (INT-T-14).
risks: Largest FM item; split assignment/SLA if behind at Day 3 midday.

items.title: Implement PPM maintenance plans, occurrence generation and 52-week planner API
items.description: Maintenance plans (RRULE, lead days, duration, checklist, default assignee, statutory flag); nightly job that materialises 52 weeks of occurrences and creates planned WOs at due − lead (skip_if_open); assignee notification (EV-092); GET /fm/planner (weekly buckets, workload minutes by trade). Planned work against assets/locations and the 52-week planner are CONFIRMED (EV-075).
acceptance: A monthly plan with lead 7 creates exactly one WO at due − 7, even when the job runs twice (FT-FM-04).
The planner returns 52 weekly columns with hour totals (FT-FM-05).
The assigned technician receives a notification (NOT-05).

items.title: Build Strata staff screens for the demo path (dashboard, schemes, lot ledger, budget/levies, receipts, bank rec, arrears, invoices)
items.description: SCR-101 (KPI tiles; charts wired once VX-070 lands), SCR-102/103/104 (scheme detail tabs: overview, lots, funds, ledger), SCR-106 budget grid + levy preview modal, SCR-107 levy runs, SCR-108 quick receipt, SCR-109 two-pane matcher + lock, SCR-110 arrears console, SCR-111/112 invoice inbox + approval. Screens are built against the API contract and can use mock data until VX-023/024/025/026 merge (Day 3–4). Staff UI is UNKNOWN for Urbanise (G-02), so these layouts are PROPOSED.
acceptance: UF-02 (budget → levy preview → approve) completes in the UI.
UF-05 bank rec: upload → auto-match summary → resolve → lock, with a typed confirmation.
Every screen shows loading, empty, error and permission states.
risks: UI depends on several backend items. Contract-first mocking mitigates.

Field PWA SCR-251/252: job list, accept, check-in (GPS), checklist, photo capture (≤ 2 MB), complete; Workbox + IndexedDB offline queue syncing via /fm/me/sync with clientEventId. The Workforce app is CONFIRMED (EV-081). The PWA in place of native apps is PROPOSED (ADR-008, C-05).

Results contain only in-scope entities.

items.title: Implement document RAG: chunking, embeddings, scope-filtered hybrid retrieval and citation validator
items.description: Indexer on document.scanned for RAG kinds (by-laws, minutes, insurance): extract text with pages (OCR fallback optional), heading-aware 800-token chunks, 1024-d embeddings, ai.document_chunks with scope_keys and visibility. Retrieval filters tenant, scope and visibility in SQL before vector + BM25 ranking with RRF top-8. Includes the search_documents tool, citation validator (cited ids ⊆ retrieved), untrusted-content delimiters, and chunk removal when a document is deleted. Source-backed answers are CONFIRMED for the partner AI (EV-114). The RAG design is PROPOSED.
acceptance: "Are pets allowed?" returns an answer citing by-laws p.7 (AIT-05).
Committee-only minutes are never retrieved for users without visibility (AIT-06); same text in T2 is never retrieved (TEN-07).
Injected instructions inside minutes are not followed (AIT-08).
A deleted document's chunks are gone within 10 min (DOC-07).

items.title: Apply security hardening: headers/CSP, rate limits, CI SAST & dependency scans, audit verifier and invariants job
items.description: Security headers and CSP on web and API; Redis token-bucket rate limits (per user, IP, pay link); body size limits; Semgrep, OSV and Trivy in CI; nightly audit hash-chain verifier; invariants job INV-01..05 with a metric; final route-permission audit; secrets review (only in env / secret manager).
acceptance: CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options and frame-ancestors are present (SEC-15).
200 requests in 10 s trigger 429 with Retry-After (API-RL-01).
SQLi and XSS payloads are neutralised (SEC-01/02); mass-assignment fields are rejected (SEC-04).
INV-01..05 pass on the seeded data.

items.title: Implement arrears engine: levels L1–L3, notices, penalties, hold, debt referral to mock collections
items.description: Arrears policy per scheme (defaults 14/35/60 days), nightly job computing buckets and levels, level-change notices and tasks, monthly penalty charges, hold/release (dispute or plan), manager-approved referral to mock collections with status webhooks. Multi-level automated arrears and the LevyCollect handoff are CONFIRMED (EV-024, EV-026); the Debtor Level field is OBSERVED (EV-025); thresholds are UNKNOWN (U-21) → configurable PROPOSED defaults pending D-04.
acceptance: At 14, 35 and 60 days overdue a lot reaches L1, L2 and L3, each with a notice (FT-ST-12).
The monthly penalty equals principal × rate × days / 365, rounded half-up (FT-ST-13).
A lot on hold receives no escalation or penalty (FT-ST-15).
Referring an L3 case sends it to mock collections, and status webhooks update the referral (FT-ST-14).

items.title: Implement supplier invoices with approval routing (staff/committee) and payment batches to mock bank

Payment batch of approved invoices from compliant suppliers only goes to the mock bank payables endpoint, with per-item status. AI extraction is POST-DAY-5. Committee approval with budget remaining is OBSERVED (EV-040); payables from the platform are CONFIRMED (EV-052).
acceptance: A $3,000 invoice routes to the manager, and a $6,000 invoice to the committee (FT-ST-17/18).
A duplicate supplier + invoice number returns 409 (FT-ST-19).
A batch rejects non-approved invoices or non-compliant suppliers (422).
When one batch item fails at the mock bank, that invoice returns to approved (INT-T-04).
